tuning.title: Game tuning
tuning.subtitle: Requested values persist as deltas. Deferred values show their active state; gameplay changes make the current run local-only.
tuning.quick_tooltip: Open runtime tuning. Default opacity is 50%; hover or focus reveals it fully.
tuning.reset_done: Requested values returned to defaults. Ranked eligibility stays sticky for this run.
tuning.sync_web: Config sent to the same-origin Manus host.
tuning.sync_native: Handoff JSON saved and copied to the clipboard: {path}
tuning.sync_failed: Config handoff could not be written.
tuning.ui.hud_opacity.description: Adjust the in-game status bar without affecting score integrity.
tuning.ui.reduced_motion.description: Disables ambient drift and replaces bursts with restrained feedback.
tuning.ui.tweak_margin.description: Moves the persistent tuning control away from the viewport edge.
tuning.audio.mute.description: Mutes every game bus while preserving individual volumes.
tuning.audio.music.description: Controls music when an optional track is assigned. Silent by default.
tuning.audio.sfx.description: Controls gameplay actions, impacts, rewards, and outcomes.
tuning.audio.ui.description: Controls menu confirmation, cancellation, and pause cues.
tuning.player.scale.description: Changes only the drawn size of the paper plane, not collision or scoring.
tuning.local_failed: Could not save; changes remain in this preview.
tuning.local_session: Changes remain in this preview; persistent browser storage is unavailable.
tuning.local_ready: Changes save automatically as a local preview draft.
tuning.gameplay.gravity.description: How hard the paper plane is pulled down. Takes effect on the next run.
tuning.gameplay.flap_speed.description: Upward speed given by each tap. Takes effect on the next run.
tuning.gameplay.scroll_speed.description: How fast the notebook page slides past. Takes effect on the next run.
tuning.gameplay.gap_size.description: Clearance inside each answer lane, before the selected difficulty adjustment. Takes effect on the next run.

pause.title: Paused
hud.question_wait: Solve it, then fly through the matching answer.
hint.addition: Break it into tens and ones, then add.
hint.subtraction: Count back or find the missing amount.
hint.division: Use multiplication to check your answer.
hint.simple_fractions: Fractions name equal parts of a whole.
hint.place_value: The tens place counts groups of ten.
hint.number_patterns: Look for the number added each time.
hint.fraction_operations: Use common denominators for +/−; multiply across or flip for ÷.
hint.measurement: Convert units first; then add, multiply, or divide.
hint.probability: Count the outcomes that fit, then divide by all possible outcomes.
hint.statistics: Order the values for the middle or range; mean is total ÷ count.
hint.decimals: Line up decimals for +/−; count places when multiplying or dividing.
hint.percentages: Percent is out of 100; increase, decrease, or scale back to find the whole.
hint.ratios: Scale both parts equally; divide by units to find a unit rate.
hint.order_operations: Powers and brackets first, then multiply/divide before add/subtract.
hint.integers: Track the sign as you combine positive and negative numbers.
hint.algebra: Undo operations in reverse to isolate x.
hint.quadratics: Factor, then solve each factor for x.
hint.geometry: Use the shape's side, angle, area, or volume rule.
practice.prompt: STEP 1 · What would you like to practice?
practice.tagline: Choose one learning pack to begin.
topics.title: Choose your math subjects
topics.subtitle: STEP 2 OF 4  ·  Pick one or more. You can change these choices later.
difficulty.title: Choose your challenge
difficulty.subtitle: STEP 3 OF 4  ·  There is no rush. Pick the level that feels right today.
difficulty.description.1: Small steps: numbers to 20, simple times tables, halves, everyday measures, shapes and chance.
difficulty.description.2: Build confidence: add/subtract to 100, tables to 10×10, fractions, units and rectangle area.
difficulty.description.3: Grow with fraction operations, decimals, percentages, ratios, data and order of operations.
difficulty.description.4: Try decimal multiplication/division, percent change, unit rates, signed numbers, algebra and right-triangle math.
difficulty.description.5: Stretch into reverse percentages, word proportions, fraction division, quadratics, trigonometry, chance and volume.
difficulty.no_topics: None of the checked subjects are unlocked at this level. Choose a higher level or go back.
difficulty.some_topics_locked: {active} of {selected} checked subjects are ready now. Others unlock at higher levels.
difficulty.all_topics_ready: All {active} checked subjects are ready at this level.
speed.title: Choose your flight pace
speed.subtitle: STEP 4 OF 4  ·  Take time to solve each question. Slower paces leave more room between gates.
speed.description.1: Slow flight and the widest spaces between answer gates.
speed.description.2: An easy glide with generous time to think.
speed.description.3: A steady glide with comfortable thinking time.
speed.description.4: A quicker glide with less time between gates.
speed.description.5: The fastest glide and closest gate spacing.
speed.independent: Flight pace changes speed and gate spacing only — not the learning challenge.
practice.pack_note: Each pack has five age-stepped levels; choose your flight pace separately.
difficulty.subtitle.math: STEP 3 OF 4 · There is no rush. Pick the level that feels right today.
difficulty.subtitle.learning: STEP 2 OF 3 · Choose a comfortable level for this pack.
difficulty.pack_summary: The {area} pack is mixed at this level. Flight pace is chosen separately.
difficulty.description.reading.1: Hear beginning sounds, recognize simple word forms, and use familiar sentences.
difficulty.description.reading.2: Read clear sentences; notice plurals, punctuation, and describing words.
difficulty.description.reading.3: Use context clues, main ideas, inferences, and common prefixes.
difficulty.description.reading.4: Interpret figurative language, evidence, word meaning, and complex sentences.
difficulty.description.reading.5: Analyze theme, figures of speech, author purpose, and evidence.
difficulty.description.russian.1: Learn greetings, common words, and Cyrillic spellings.
difficulty.description.russian.2: Build common colors, numbers, objects, and polite phrases.
difficulty.description.russian.3: Read short present-tense phrases and common word endings.
difficulty.description.russian.4: Practice past and future forms, case endings, and short translations.
difficulty.description.russian.5: Stretch into conditional forms, verb aspect, and richer sentences.
difficulty.description.spanish.1: Learn greetings and familiar words with clear English cues.
difficulty.description.spanish.2: Build simple phrases, plurals, familiar nouns, and present-tense forms.
difficulty.description.spanish.3: Read short sentences; use present tense, agreement, and a simple past.
difficulty.description.spanish.4: Practice past, conditional, formal address, and adjective agreement.
difficulty.description.spanish.5: Stretch into the subjunctive, conditional meaning, and connectors.
difficulty.description.science.1: Explore animals, plants, senses, and everyday matter.
difficulty.description.science.2: Learn life cycles, forces, materials, Earth, and space.
difficulty.description.science.3: Connect ecosystems, water and weather cycles, energy, and fair tests.
difficulty.description.science.4: Study cells, electric current, pH, and Earth's structure.
difficulty.description.science.5: Use high-school biology, chemistry, and physics concepts.
speed.subtitle.math: STEP 4 OF 4 · Take time to solve each question. Slower paces leave more room between gates.
speed.subtitle.learning: STEP 3 OF 3 · Take time to answer. Slower paces leave more room between gates.
hint.reading.phonics: Listen for the shared beginning or ending sound.
hint.reading.comprehension: Use the sentence details to find what happened or why.
hint.reading.grammar: Nouns name people or things; verbs show action; adjectives describe.
hint.reading.vocabulary: Use nearby clues and word parts to work out the meaning.
hint.reading.literature: Use the author's words and details as evidence.
hint.russian.vocabulary: Connect each Cyrillic word with its English meaning.
hint.russian.phrases: Read the whole phrase; its meaning may differ from one word alone.
hint.russian.grammar: Russian endings show tense and a noun's role in the sentence.
hint.spanish.vocabulary: Match the Spanish word or connector to its English meaning.
hint.spanish.phrases: Read the full phrase, not just one word.
hint.spanish.grammar: Check the subject, tense, and agreement before choosing.
hint.science.life: Living things grow and interact; plants use light and carbon dioxide.
hint.science.physical: Think about matter, forces, motion, and how energy moves.
hint.science.earth: Use Earth's rotation, layers, water cycle, and space patterns.
hint.science.methods: In a fair test, change one variable and use evidence.
hint.science.biology: Connect cells, DNA, and how living systems work.
hint.science.chemistry: Track electrons, particles, and reaction conditions.
hint.science.physics: Use relationships between speed, force, motion, and energy.
